title: A landed analysis and its attached files survive leaving the Analyze tab
deviations_from_card: (1) Added a third pure function settleAnalyzeRestore(httpStatus, body) so the 404/corrupt-drops-crumb case (acceptance 8) is testable without a renderer; a 5xx keeps the crumb (transient), any other non-2xx drops it. (2) A new submit clears the landed-result crumb but NOT the held attachments: wiping the files the running submit just used would defeat the card's purpose; reset clears both. (3) The attachment store's take() is a non-draining snapshot (React may run an initializer twice under StrictMode); put() refuses outside a browser so a server module never holds a CV. (4) The restored result is routed through applyGithubDeepDive by shaping row.githubAnalysis as githubDeepDive {status:'done'} (per slot A's handler) and sets servedFromCache null (a restore delivered nothing). (5) Write set shrank: no change needed beyond the listed files.
notes: Client-only; 15 node:test cases cover the 8 acceptance lines (all red before: modules missing). tsc whole-tree is red ONLY on sibling in-flight paths (aging-policy/attention, interview-session-transitions, pipeline-automation-input, interview/complete route, about/AboutTab, and the untracked kpi-sim/ copy) - zero errors under app/features/tools/analyze or messages. Full test:unit red (exit 1) only on app/_lib db tests none of which import the analyze feature (aging-policy, erasure-*-scrub, match-candidate, offers-store, pipeline-github-handle, rematch-source) - sibling edits to app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts et al. are uncommitted in the tree. test:perf red on 43 app/api/**/route.ts import-graph lines (server graphs, same sibling cause); no client/app/page.tsx line, and nothing under features/tools/analyze is imported by a route. Analyze folder suite: 144/144. Messages (2 keys x 4 locales) and the candidates README were each committed alone under the shared-surface lock.
